items.problem: MediaElement -> MediaPlayerElement migration: the imperative code-behind API surface is not 1:1, and the skill's note is misleading. Build failed (WMC0001) and code-behind required rewrites: MediaElement.SetSource(stream,type) and MediaElement.GetAsCastingSource() do not exist on MediaPlayerElement.
items.evidence: session-log.txt L3132-3134 (WMC0001 'Unknown type MediaElement' x3); L3157-3195 (SetSource -> MediaSource.CreateFromStream; GetAsCastingSource() -> MediaPlayer.GetAsCastingSource()); generated Scenario2_CastingDevicePicker.xaml.cs L72,102.
items.wrong_text_if_any: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md element-swap table (~L623): '<MediaElement .../> | <MediaPlayerElement .../> | Source and transport-control properties carry over with minor renames.'
items.root_cause: MediaPlayerElement is a view over an underlying MediaPlayer. It has no SetSource and no playback/casting methods; element.Source takes an IMediaPlaybackSource (MediaSource.CreateFromStream/CreateFromUri), and Play/Pause/GetAsCastingSource/PlaybackSession live on element.MediaPlayer. The 'minor renames' note hides all of this.
items.proposed_fix: Correct the element-swap table note and add a focused subsection (anchor #media-element) documenting the code-behind delegation mapping: SetSource->Source=MediaSource.CreateFrom*, Play/Pause/Stop/GetAsCastingSource/position/volume->via .MediaPlayer; AreTransportControlsEnabled/AutoPlay stay on the element. Add a pointer from the Controls table row too.
items.generalizes: Every UWP app that plays or casts media uses MediaElement with imperative SetSource/Play/Pause/GetAsCastingSource in code-behind. The same XAML-compiles-but-code-behind-breaks failure recurs in any media player, video sample, podcast, or casting scenario, independent of this specific sample.
